notes.protocol: ISO 15765-4 CAN 11 bit 500 kbaud, as used by the phone app and confirmed with the adapter
notes.redline_rpm: the owner's chosen limit (not the engine's maximum): shift lights and the RPM band use it
notes.engine_litres: 1.2 Revotron displacement; used by the backup fuel estimate
notes.gear_ratios: Tata doesn't publish them; assumed in an engineering exercise (LinkedIn, Suriaa)
notes.rpm_per_kmh: measured with --calibrate-gears on 2026-10-24 from all drives so far: gears 1-4 measured (4th from the 2026-10-24 drive in M mode); 5th barely driven, so theory scaled by the +8.0 % the measured gears came out above it. Re-run --calibrate-gears after holding 5th steady on a drive.
notes.spec: Tata's published figures for the BS6 1.2 Revotron, as listed by CarWale (XT Rhythm page); older BS4 listings say 114 Nm at 3500 rpm
notes.torque_calibration: From the drive on 2026-10-24: the ECU's torque % read 12 at warm idle (AC off, no torque to the wheels) and 56 at full throttle around 3000-3600 rpm (manifold 89-90 kPa = wide open). The spec's 113 Nm corrected (SAE J1349) to that drive's air, 91 kPa and 36 C intake, is about 100 Nm. Read raw, the ECU's % of its 106 Nm reference gave only ~60 Nm there. An estimate: expect +-10 %.
notes.smart_alternator: Drive 2026-10-24: 14.0 V on average while slowing down, 13.4 V while accelerating, below 13 V for 31 % of the time (lows 12.1-12.5 V); every 5 minutes still peaked at 13.8 V or more.
